title: Sunflower Power Poses
description: Four sequential animated-style illustrations of a young female character with sunflower-themed accessories and a tail, performing different magical hand gestures against a vibrant green background. Golden sunflower petals, glowing yellow energy, and sparkles emanate from her hands and body as she shifts through dynamic stances.
prompt: A four-panel sequence of a cute anime girl with spiky black hair, wearing a yellow sunflower crop top, frilled yellow skirt, black leggings, and heavy yellow boots. She has a long black tail, sunflower goggles on her head, and fingerless gloves. She is casting bright golden magical energy and sunflower petals from her hands in different dynamic poses, glowing yellow aura, vibrant solid green background, energetic magical girl style, clean comic illustration
